title: Relative clauses: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: The woman ___ lives next door is a nurse.
This is the town ___ I was born.
items.explanationEs: Un lugar donde pasó algo: where.

items.statement: The book which I'm reading is very good.
The man which helped me was very kind.
items.explanationEs: Una persona: The man who (o that) helped me.

answers: That's the girl whose brother is a pilot.
items.explanationEs: De quién es el hermano: whose (cuyo). Who's es who is.

answers: The film we watched last night was boring.
items.explanationEs: El relativo que es objeto se puede quitar (the film that we watched). Nunca se repite it.
